scripts.text:
[Girl]
You're not ready.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
你還沒準備好。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Hey? Stop!
Aren't you interested in hearing a funny story?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
嘿？停下！
你不想知道一個有趣的故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Girl]
If you have any interest... just go!
Do you know where the guild is?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
如果你感興趣的話...那就去吧！
你知道公會在哪裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Wow, you look busy.
Have you heard that there are visiters?
They're on a treasure hunt!
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
哇，你看起來很忙。
你聽說有訪客來了嗎？
他們正在尋寶！

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Eh?
I don't have anything for you...
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
呃？
我沒有什麼給你的...

scripts.text: What story?
scripts.translation: 什麼故事？

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Have you been to the guild recently?
Some interesting things have happened lately.
Maybe new guests...
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
你最近去過公會嗎？
最近發生了一些有趣的事情。
也許是新來的客人...

scripts.text:
[Girl]
I heard it has to do with something called a Shadow Chaser.
You should go and check it out.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
我聽說這和一種叫做逐影獵人的東西有關。
你應該去看看。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Every time they visit us, they are on new missions.
What missions are they doing I wonder?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
每次他們來訪，都有新的任務。
不知道他們在執行什麼任務呢？

scripts.text:
[Girl]
It is in a fortress under Pharos lighthouse.
Sigh....
You must visit there!
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
它在發樂斯燈塔島下面的堡壘裡。
唉...
你一定要去那裡看看！

scripts.text:
[Girl]
It must be fun.
I wanna try!
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
那一定很有趣。
我想去試試！

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Hey? Stop!
Aren't you interested in hearing a funny story?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
嘿？停下！
你不想知道一個有趣的故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vin]
Ah? What's this?
Lotte, you know what this means?
scripts.translation:
[文]
啊？這是什麼？
洛特，你知道這意味著什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lotte]
Hmm '3847147298' this is the only thing I've used on...
Then, why'd they use numbers to name the villages?
scripts.translation:
[洛特]
嗯，'3847147298' 這是我唯一用過的...
那麼，為什麼他們用數字來命名村莊呢？

scripts.text:
[Lotte]
Vin! This is crap!
scripts.translation:
[洛特]
文！這太糟糕了！

scripts.text:
[Vin]
What?
scripts.translation:
[文]
什麼？

scripts.text:
[Scary man]
Hey there?
scripts.translation:
[嚇人的男子]
嘿，那裡？

scripts.text: Me?
scripts.translation: 我嗎？

scripts.text: Sorry, I am busy...
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙...

scripts.text:
[Scary man]
Yes! You there!
Let me introduce myself to you.
My name is Urupa.
If you are interested, could you come over here?
scripts.translation:
[嚇人的男子]
是的！就是你！
讓我向你介紹一下自己。
我的名字是烏魯帕。
如果你感興趣，能過來一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Scary man]
What? You're just going to give up like that?
So disappointing...
scripts.translation:
[嚇人的男子]
什麼？你就要這樣放棄嗎？
真令人失望...

scripts.text:
[Scary man]
You are supposed to figure this one out!
But you are still so... weak.
scripts.translation:
[嚇人的男子]
你應該能解開這個謎題的！
但你還是太...弱了。

scripts.text:
[Vin]
Yes...
Sooner or later I'll solve it myself if I dare to get the map...!
scripts.translation:
[文]
是的...
遲早我會自己解開它的，只要我敢去拿那張地圖...！

scripts.text:
[Vin]
Huh! This is a Shadow Chaser!
How unbelievable!
But it seems familiar doesn't it?
scripts.translation:
[文]
哈！這是一個逐影獵人！
真是難以置信！
但感覺有點熟悉，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vin]
Hmm......
..........
Oh my! I can't remember...!

[Vin]
Ah? Who's there?
We are flooded with guests today...
scripts.translation:
[文]
啊？是誰？
今天客人真多啊...

scripts.text:
[Lotte]
What?
Damn...
scripts.translation:
[洛特]
什麼？
該死...

scripts.text:
[Lotte]
I just hate numbers!
scripts.translation:
[洛特]
我最討厭數字了！

scripts.text:
[Lotte]
Wow!
You are the one!
Just extraordinary smart and emotionally advanced...
scripts.translation:
[洛特]
哇！
就是你！
真是聰明絕頂，情商又高...

scripts.text:
[Lotte]
SHADOW CHASER!
Wow when could I become one.
scripts.translation:
[洛特]
逐影獵人！
哇，我什麼時候才能成為那樣的人啊。

scripts.text:
[Lotte]
I don't need anything.
scripts.translation:
[洛特]
我什麼都不需要。

scripts.text:
[Scary man]
Oh you are so talented?
Now I have one interesting quetion! Do you want it solved?
scripts.translation:
[烏魯帕]
哦，你很有天賦嗎？
那我有一個有趣的問題！你想解開它嗎？

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
My name is Urupa.
If you have anything interesting just challenge it.
scripts.translation:
[烏魯帕]
我的名字是烏魯帕。
如果你有什麼有趣的事，儘管來挑戰吧。

scripts.text:
[Scary man]
What's your business?
I don't have anything to do with you.
I don't care for people like you. I just deal with the extraordinary.
scripts.translation:
[烏魯帕]
你找我有何貴幹？
我跟你沒什麼關係。
我不喜歡像你這樣的人。我只跟非凡的人打交道。

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
We give a quiz and nobody has yet to solve it.
You want it to be solved?
This is a code.
Look at it.
scripts.translation:
[烏魯帕]
我們出了一個謎題，至今無人能解。
你想解開它嗎？
這是一個密碼。
看看這個。

scripts.text:
- The message is -
- written in a cipher. -
The mission seems to be to break the code...
scripts.translation:
- 這條資訊 -
- 是用密碼寫成的。 -
任務似乎是破解這個密碼...

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
This is the code.
It is just numbering a cipher to make the message make sense.
For example...
scripts.translation:
[烏魯帕]
這是密碼。
它只是給密碼編號，讓資訊變得有意義。
例如...

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
Now here's what needs to be to solved.
Decipher the code and go where it tells you...
scripts.translation:
[烏魯帕]
現在，這裡是需要解開的部分。
破解密碼，然後去它告訴你的地方...

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
So write this down!
I expected that you would take this adventure!
scripts.translation:
[烏魯帕]
所以把這個記下來！
我預料到你會接受這個冒險！

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
You want one more explanation?
Or do you just want the code?
scripts.translation:
[烏魯帕]
你想再聽一次解釋？
還是直接要密碼？

scripts.text: More explanation.
scripts.translation: 再解釋一下

scripts.text: Get the code.
scripts.translation: 獲取密碼

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
Now it's up to you!
So go! Go!
scripts.translation:
[烏魯帕]
現在就看你的了！
去吧！快去吧！

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
Let me show you the code again...
scripts.translation:
[烏魯帕]
讓我再給你展示一次密碼...

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
Ok, have you solved it yet?
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[烏魯帕]
好了，你解出來了嗎？
祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
You have just become a Shadow Chaser.
The quizzes are for collecting the right people...
scripts.translation:
[烏魯帕]
你剛剛成為了一名逐影獵人。
這些測驗是為了篩選出合適的人...

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
Nothing special?
As you see... I am ok here!
scripts.translation:
[烏魯帕]
沒什麼特別的？
你看...我在這裡挺好的！

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
3511543433
This means PAYON.

[Urupa]
The numbers have to be paired.
3511543433
35 11 54 34 33 breaks down into 5 pairs!
scripts.translation:
[烏魯帕]
數字必須兩兩配對。
3511543433
35 11 54 34 33 可以拆分為5對！

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
So the pairs mean:
35 - P, 11 - A,
54 - Y, 34 - O, 33 - N.

[Urupa]
Here are the numbers all in a row.
33, 34, 35!
N , O , P ?
scripts.translation:
[烏魯帕]
這裡有一排數字。
33, 34, 35!
N , O , P ?

scripts.text: Here we go!
scripts.translation: 開始吧！

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
Could you do that?
If you visit there, you might be surprised...
scripts.translation:
[烏魯帕]
你能做到嗎？
如果你去那裡看看，可能會大吃一驚...

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Where's Max!?
Damn, there're so many strangers around.
Hey...
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
麥克斯在哪裡！？
該死，周圍全是陌生人。
嘿...

scripts.text: Show the deciphered code!
scripts.translation: 展示破解後的密碼！

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Wow, you deciphered it?
So, what's the right answer?
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
哇，你破解出來了？
那麼，正確答案是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Good.
You just got it.
Then why have you come over here?
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
很好。
你答對了。
那你為什麼來這裡？

scripts.text: The code says here's the one...
scripts.translation: 密碼說這裡就是...

scripts.text:
[Manager]
So you are the one.
Could you wait for a sec'?
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
原來你就是那個人。
能稍等一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Remember to put the code exactly as it should be deciphered.
Maybe you should try again...
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
記得把密碼完全按照破解後的樣子填寫。
也許你應該再試一次...

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Only allowed for people involved....
Could you ask the clerk at the shop?
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
僅限相關人員使用...
你能去問問商店的店員嗎？

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Now let me introduce myself to you!
I am Graham, the manager of this shadow gallery...
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
現在讓我正式介紹一下自己！
我是格雷厄姆，這家地下畫廊的管理員...

scripts.text:
[Graham]
You may have already guessed.
This is an additional facility for rogues.
We adopt things like art and other historical stuff.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
你可能已經猜到了。
這是為流氓準備的額外設施。
我們收藏藝術品和其他歷史文物。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
These things are illegal.
Such things you guys bring us from historical places...
Ok.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
這些東西是非法的。
你們從歷史遺蹟帶回來的那些東西...
好吧。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
So we've got to know things like...
special codes and information where the treasures are.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
所以我們必須掌握一些資訊...
比如特殊的密碼，以及寶物藏在哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
We need you guys...
So we've asked assistance from the Rogue guild.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
我們需要你們...
所以我們向流氓公會尋求了援助。

scripts.text: Any other places you guys work?
scripts.translation: 你們還在其他地方有業務嗎？

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Ah, yes...
We are in Prontera, Juno, Rachel, and Lighthalzen.
Ok?
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
啊，是的...
我們在普隆德拉、朱諾、拉赫和裡希塔樂鎮都有據點。
明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Anyway....
We all really want to know where the treasures are.
So the code is to break into each of those places.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
總之....
我們都非常想知道寶物在哪裡。
所以密碼就是用來潛入那些地方的。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
You seem like the right one.
So I will give you the code.
Please find the treasure!
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
你看起來就是合適的人選。
所以我會把密碼給你。
請找到寶物！

scripts.text: No way!
scripts.translation: 絕對不行！

scripts.text: I'll give it a try!
scripts.translation: 我會試試看的！

scripts.text:
[Graham]
What the hell?
If you are not going to help then I'll just find someone else.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
該死的？
如果你不打算幫忙，我就去找別人了。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
You are so powerful!
So here...
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
你真的很厲害！
那麼這裡...

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Are you interested in it now?
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
你現在感興趣了嗎？

scripts.text: Not at all.
scripts.translation: 一點都不喜歡。

scripts.text: Hmm, I'll take it.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我收下。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Damn it.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
該死的。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
You are just so picky...
Here...
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
你真是挑剔...
這裡...

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Did you find something?
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
你找到什麼東西了嗎？

scripts.text: I need an explanation.
scripts.translation: 我需要解釋一下。

scripts.text: What's the code again?
scripts.translation: 密碼是什麼來著？

scripts.text:
[Graham]
You are so powerful!
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
你真是厲害！

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Got it?
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
記住了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Graham]
I've given you the code.
So crazy...
Don't you have a memo of it?
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
我已經把密碼給你了。
真是瘋了...
你沒有備忘錄嗎？

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Nothing special...?
You've been to places...?
There's definetely something.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
沒什麼特別的...？
你去過那些地方...？
肯定有什麼東西。

scripts.text:
Graham seems to know something.
I'd better go there again.
scripts.translation:
格雷厄姆似乎知道些什麼。
我最好再去一趟。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
So, any improvements?
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
那麼，有什麼進展嗎？

scripts.text: Show him the key.
scripts.translation: 給他看鑰匙

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Deception!
You are deceiving me!
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
欺騙！
你在欺騙我！

scripts.text:
[Graham]
This is all?
Only one key.
How deceptive!
Just as I thought, it's a kind of treasure.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
就這些？
只有一把鑰匙。
真是狡猾！
果然，這是一種寶物。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
You just gave me a shock.
Ok...
The code is kept in galleries.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
你真是嚇了我一跳。
好吧...
密碼儲存在畫廊裡。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Ok there's more galleries than this one...
Juno and Rachel have the codes...
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
好吧，畫廊不止這一家...
朱諾和拉赫那裡有密碼...

scripts.text:
[Graham]
This is just what I was guessing.
The codes kept by other galleries aren't treasures at all...
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
這正如我所料。
其他畫廊儲存的密碼根本不是寶物...

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Go to Rachel...
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
去拉赫...

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Find the gallery in Rachel...
Tell 'em that you just came from Graham and ask for the code.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
找到拉赫的畫廊...
告訴他們你是格雷厄姆派來的，然後索要密碼。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Ok?
Then go there!
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
明白了嗎？
那就去吧！

scripts.text:
[Graham]
There're four galleries...
Prontera, Rachel, Juno, and Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
一共有四家畫廊...
普隆德拉、拉赫、朱諾，還有裡希塔樂鎮。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
One of the codes kept by the galleries is already deciphered.
It's just one key....
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
畫廊儲存的密碼中，已經有一個被破解了。
它只是一把鑰匙....

scripts.text:
[Graham]
But here's what I am guessing.
The codes are linked to each other.
And the purpose is different for each one.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
但我猜測是這樣的。
這些密碼是相互關聯的。
而且每一個的用途都不同。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
For example...
If one is just a key then the others are things requiring the key.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
舉個例子...
如果一個是鑰匙，那麼其他的就需要這把鑰匙。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
The key must be for opening the box.
Can you guess what's inside?
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
這把鑰匙肯定是用來開啟箱子的。
你能猜到裡面是什麼嗎？

scripts.text: Umm, treasure?
scripts.translation: 嗯，是寶物？

scripts.text:
[Graham]
YES.
That's why we're here!
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
沒錯。
這就是我們在這裡的原因！

scripts.text:
[Graham]
People think that we are just trading the stuff...
But we are here for very special things.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
人們以為我們只是在交易貨物...
但我們是為了非常特別的東西而來的。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Go to ^4d4dffRachel Gallery^000000 and get the code...
They will support you if you explain everything.
Ok?
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
去^4d4dff拉赫畫廊^000000獲取密碼...
如果你把情況解釋清楚，他們會支援你的。
好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Graham]
How about everything?
We are dying to know about the key.
So you got support from the other galleries.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
關於一切，你覺得怎麼樣？
我們迫切地想知道關於鑰匙的事。
所以你獲得了其他畫廊的支援。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Shadow Chaser!!
Ah!
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
逐影獵人！！
啊！

scripts.text:
[Graham]
It's not intentionally decieving...
Hahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
這不是故意欺騙...
哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Isn't it interesting?
It's more than just taking exams.
We got to know about you and figured out who you are.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
這不是很有趣嗎？
這不僅僅是考試。
我們瞭解了你，並弄清了你是誰。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
How's my acting?
It worked?
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
我的演技如何？
起作用了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Graham]
If you need anything just ask them what you want.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
如果你需要什麼，直接問他們你要什麼。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Only allowed for people involved...
Could you ask the clerk at the shop?
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
僅限相關人員...

見見裡希塔樂鎮商店的店主維森特，告訴他一切。

[Haled]
I told you that the old man is persistant and he ruins everything.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
我告訴過你，那個老人很固執，而且他會毀掉一切。

scripts.text:
[Haled]
You have to have all your facts straight to send information to the guild.
First you have to work together in one accord.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
向公會發送資訊時，你必須確保所有事實都準確無誤。
首先你們必須達成一致，協同合作。

scripts.text:
[Haled]
The thing you find can belong to the workplace.
It can be shared.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
你找到的東西可能屬於工作場所。
它可以被共享。

scripts.text:
[Haled]
I thought that it was a very simple thing.
We couldn't share that stuff together.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
我以為那是件非常簡單的事。
我們卻無法共享那些東西。

scripts.text:
[Haled]
All of the information that I got from workplace are key.
There must be something to use three key with.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
我從工作場所獲得的所有資訊都很關鍵。
一定有什麼東西需要用到這三把鑰匙。

scripts.text:
[Haled]
Anyway it has to do with deceit and pleasure...
Is it teasing me...
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
總之，這與欺騙和享樂有關...
是在戲弄我嗎...

scripts.text:
[Haled]
Ok. Let me finish.
Go to Vicente in Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
好了，讓我說完。
去裡希塔樂鎮找維森特。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry.
I found one more key but I didn't bring it.
I'll bring it soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉。
我又找到了一把鑰匙，但我沒帶過來。
我很快就會送過去。

scripts.text:
[Haled]
Shadow workplace in Lighthalzen.
The manager's name is Vicente.
Tell him everything and get one last information.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
裡希塔樂鎮的影子工作場所。
管理員的名字是維森特。
告訴他一切，並獲取最後一條資訊。

scripts.text:
[Haled]
Hey, you!
Was Vicente helpful to you?
You have something important...
So you have to find out what is it.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
嘿，你！
維森特對你有幫助嗎？
你身上有重要的東西...
所以你必須弄清楚那是什麼。

scripts.text:
[Haled]
Keep trying.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
繼續嘗試。

scripts.text:
[Haled]
Hey, you!
What's going on?
What? Shadow Chaser?
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
嘿，你！
發生什麼事了？
什麼？逐影獵人？

scripts.text:
[Haled]
Did I know that fact?
Sure. I heard a little bit before
I used to do work like this.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
我知道這個事實嗎？
當然。我之前聽說過一點。
我以前也做過類似的工作。

scripts.text:
[Haled]
It's an honor for me to pick a person who belongs to us.
Just accept that. You are going to be a good Shadow Chaser.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
能挑選一位屬於我們的人，是我的榮幸。
就接受這個事實吧。你會成為一名優秀的逐影獵人。

scripts.text:
[Haled]
I like your face.
We don't have any special thing.
An assistant sells some paint and tool.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
我喜歡你的臉。
我們這裡沒有什麼特別的東西。
助手賣一些顏料和工具。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Paul said...

[Haled]
Ekk... He...
Knew everything...
Hmm...
I can help.
I will cooperate.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
呃...他...
什麼都知道...
嗯...
我可以幫忙。
我會配合的。

scripts.text:
[Haled]
I need some time to collect my thoughts.
Wait for me a bit.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
我需要一點時間整理思緒。
等我一下。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
You are?
Sorry, but we don't trade old art goods.
If you neeed something, then ask an assistant.
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
你是？
抱歉，我們不交易舊藝術品。
如果你需要什麼，請詢問助手。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Welcome.
I've been waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
歡迎光臨。
我一直在等你。

scripts.text: For me?
scripts.translation: 給我？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
I wondered when you would visit.
I've been waiting a long time for you.
Huhu...
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
我猜你什麼時候會來。
我等你很久了。
呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
How were Graham,Paul and Haled?
They are not easy people to deal with huh?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
格雷厄姆、保羅和哈雷德怎麼樣？
他們應該不好對付吧？

scripts.text: You know everything?
scripts.translation: 你全都知道？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Sure.
They ignore me because they think that I'm too young.
As if they were all perfect. HahahaHah...
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
當然。
他們無視我，覺得我太年輕了。
好像他們都很完美似的。哈哈哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Did you bring all of the keys?
There should be three.
You came here to find out how to use them I assume, right?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
你把所有的鑰匙都帶來了嗎？
應該有把。
我猜你是來這裡想知道怎麼使用它們的，對吧？

scripts.text: Yeah, you're right!
scripts.translation: 沒錯，你猜對了！

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
You don't have to be surprised.
I can't find how long it took for those three men to investigate before.
I already finished my work.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
你不必驚訝。
我甚至不知道那三個人之前花了多少時間進行調查。
我已經完成我的工作。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
When I went to the final location I found a stone statue.
But it needs to have key.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
當我到達最終地點時，我發現了一尊石像。
但它需要鑰匙。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Even Three.
 
(Vicente smiles)
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
甚至需要三把。

(維森特微笑)

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
At first, the information that was given from the guild means only one thing.
Because of the saying that they respect the right of our possessions,
we shared our information.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
起初，公會提供的資訊只意味著一件事。
因為他們尊重我們對物品的所有權，
所以我們共享了資訊。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
So we had to wait for it.
I thought the last man would never give it to me...
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
所以我們不得不等待。
我以為最後那個人永遠不會把它給我...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
They thought I wanted to have the treasure for myself.
So that's why I've just been waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
他們以為我想把寶物據為己有。
所以我一直在等你。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Then let's make a point!
Do you know thanatos tower?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
那麼讓我們進入正題！
你知道達納托斯塔嗎？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然。

scripts.text: The tower of death?
scripts.translation: 死亡之塔？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
You know that.
Then you can understand easily.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
你知道的。
那你應該很容易理解。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Yes, that tower in northen Juno.
There are huge monsters there.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
是的，朱諾北邊的那座塔。
那裡有巨大的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
You told me that you went to the final place with the information?
That's the Thanatos Tower.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
你告訴我，你帶著資訊去了最終地點？
那就是達納托斯塔。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Fortunately, the location is the 1st floor of that tower.
So I'm going to tell what you have to do.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
幸運的是，地點在那座塔的一樓。
所以我要告訴你該怎麼做。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
At the 1st floor of thanatos tower, there are members from the Rekenber Corporation.
Go north from their desk...
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
在達納托斯塔的一樓，有雷肯貝爾公司的成員。
從他們的辦公桌往北走...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
And you can find stairs and a location where light comes out of.
That's the location of the information that I have.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
你會找到樓梯和一個有光線射出的地方。
那就是我擁有的資訊所在的位置。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Now you know the location you have to go to with the three keys.
Find out the secret of the stone statue.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
現在你知道帶著三把鑰匙要去的地方了。
解開石像的秘密吧。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
You can't imagine what kind of things you might find.
That's the final destination of all of the keys.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
你無法想像那裡可能藏著什麼樣的東西。
那是所有鑰匙的最終目的地。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Listen carefully.
The location you need to find is
north from middle of thanatos 1st floor.
You can find stairs and a location where light comes out.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
仔細聽好。
你需要找的地方在達納托斯塔一樓中央的北邊。
你會看到樓梯和一個有光線射出的地方。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
If you find something, come back here.
Actually, I want to get the key from you, but...
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
如果你找到了什麼，就回來這裡。
其實，我想從你那裡拿走鑰匙，但是...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
I just respect your opinion.
If you find something, come back here. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
我只是尊重你的意見。
如果你找到了什麼，就回來這裡。明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
You are back?
Find anything?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
你回來了？
找到什麼了嗎？

scripts.text: Throw the brush.
scripts.translation: 扔出刷子

scripts.text: Grab him by the collar.
scripts.translation: 抓住他的衣領

scripts.text: Drop the brush.
scripts.translation: 放下刷子

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Hey, what are you doing?
This brush...
Is this the treasure hidden in the Thanatos Tower?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
嘿，你在做什麼？
這把刷子...
這就是藏在達納托斯塔的寶物嗎？

scripts.text: Vicente looks surprised after taking a look at it.
scripts.translation: 維森特看了一眼後，露出了驚訝的表情。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
What's wrong with you?
You can tell me more details?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
你怎麼了？
能告訴我更多細節嗎？

scripts.text: Vincente looks surpised after taking a look at it.
scripts.translation: 維森特看了一眼後，露出了驚訝的表情。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Is this the treasure hidden in the Thanatos Tower?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
這就是藏在達納托斯塔的寶物嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
What the matter?
Are you ok?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
怎麼了？
你沒事吧？

scripts.text: Vicente looks at me with a surprised face.
scripts.translation: 維森特用驚訝的眼神看著我。

scripts.text: Point at the brush.
scripts.translation: 指向刷子

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Is this the treasure hidden in the Thanatos Tower?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
這就是藏在達納托斯塔的寶物嗎？

scripts.text: Vincente looks surpised after taking a look at it.
scripts.translation: 維森特看了一眼後，露出了驚訝的表情。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Haha!!
Ahahahaha!!!!!
I got it now!
Congratulations.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
哈哈！！
啊哈哈哈哈哈！！！！
我懂了！
恭喜你。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
It's treasure.
You found a big treasure!
Talk to me for bit, won't you?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
這是寶物。
你找到了一個大寶物！
跟我聊一會兒，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
There is someone who has been waiting for you.
He's been waiting for someone to bring this brush back.
Let's go inside.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
有個人一直在等你。
他一直在等有人把這把刷子帶回來。
我們進去吧。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
I'm going to listen to your story.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
我要聽聽你的故事。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
I'm expecting your work from now on.
You must be a good Shadow Chaser.
I'm sure of it.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
從現在開始，我期待你的表現。
你一定是個優秀的逐影獵人。
我對此深信不疑。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
If you don't have anything special to do here, you'd better leave.
No trespassing.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
如果你在這裡沒什麼特別的事，最好離開。
禁止擅闖。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
This way.
He's been waiting for you a while.
Not me, Dumk.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
這邊請。
他等你很久了。
不是我，是鄧克。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Dumk wants to have you as a Shadow Chaser.
Big news right?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
鄧克想讓你成為逐影獵人。
這可是個大新聞，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
I'm expecting your work from now on.
You must be a good Shadow Chaser.
I'm sure of it.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
從現在開始，我期待你的表現。
你一定是個優秀的逐影獵人。
我對此深信不疑。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
I don't have any special reason to visit here.
An assistant sells tools and paint.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
我來這裡沒有特別的原因。
助手在賣工具和顏料。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
What is it?
Have you been enjoying your new skills?
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
怎麼了？
你的新技能用得還順手嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
If you want to improve your skills, you have to seek out new uses for paint.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
如果你想提升技能，就必須去探索顏料的新用途。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Don't forget.
We are Shadow Chasers.
Huhu...
HuhuHuhu...
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
別忘了。
我們是逐影獵人。
呼呼...
呼呼呼呼...

scripts.text: - You can't continue on in this quest because you are overweight. -
scripts.translation: - 因為你超重了，無法繼續這個任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Who is this guy? Why should he sit in front of me so high?
Although I do not know why you riding on it, but here is in door,
That is no danger to rely on animals to escape, so you please get down!
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
這傢伙是誰？為什麼坐得比我高？
雖然我不知道你為什麼騎在上面，但這裡是室內，
靠動物逃跑毫無危險可言，所以請下來！

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Vicente. No Soliciting.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
維森特。禁止推銷。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
A solicitor?
I don't think so. He's our colleage.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
推銷員？
我不這麼認為。他是我們的同事。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
...Ah?

[Dumk]
You are still green!
Did you expect that you can learn the dark arts with your ability?
You are wrong!
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
你還是個新手！
你以為憑你的能力就能學會黑暗藝術嗎？
你錯了！

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Haha...
Please, understand. Dumk has very bad communication skills.
Even doesn't talk to anyone who isn't a high enough level.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
哈哈...
請多包涵。鄧克的溝通能力很差。
他甚至不跟等級不夠高的人說話。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
And as person who isn't not ready.
^4d4dffYou maybe are not ready for him^000000.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
而且對於還沒準備好的人來說，
^4d4dff你可能還沒準備好面對他^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
You talk too much.
Heh.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
你話太多了。
哼。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
- He is pleased. -
Hey.
He could be ashamed.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
- 他很高興。 -
嘿。
他可能會感到羞愧。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
It's you? You are the one who found the brush?
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
是你嗎？你就是找到那把刷子的人？

scripts.text: Show the brush to him.
scripts.translation: 把刷子給他看

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
That's it.
Did you find it by yourself?
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
就是這把。
是你自己找到的嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: With my friends
scripts.translation: 和朋友一起

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Hmm...
You have a high ability.
Breaking the codes should have been tough.
But it wasn't for you.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
嗯...
你的能力很高。
破解密碼應該很困難。
但對你來說並不是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Hmm...
That's your other skill.
People who have no friends must be lonely.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
嗯...
那是你的另一種技能。
沒有朋友的人一定很孤獨。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
To us, relationships are very important.
You get more people, you get more help.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
對我們來說，人際關係非常重要。
認識的人越多，得到的幫助就越多。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
It's time to introduce myself.
I'm Dumk.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
是時候自我介紹了。
我是鄧克。

scripts.text: You are...
scripts.translation: 你是...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Chicken! How about the chicken for this supper?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
小雞！今晚的晚餐吃雞肉怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Why chicken?
Why are you interrupting?
You wanna be fired?
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
為什麼是雞肉？
你為什麼插嘴？
你想被解僱嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Sorry...
 
(He turns to you and says it's taboo to talk about chicken.)
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
抱歉...

（他轉向你，說談論小雞是禁忌。）

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Anyway, let's make a point.
You.
Will you yield to the will of the brush?
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
總之，讓我們說正事。
你。
你願意順從刷子的意志嗎？

scripts.text: Yield to? What?
scripts.translation: 順從？什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
This brush was used by the master.
Paintings by him have mysterious power.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
這把刷子是師父用過的。
他畫的畫擁有神秘的力量。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
I can't tell you the root of the power.
Someday you will find out.
He sublimates power through the medium of his paintings.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
我無法告訴你力量的根源。
總有一天你會明白的。
他通過畫作這一媒介昇華力量。

scripts.text: I don't get it...?
scripts.translation: 我不明白...

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
We walk in darkness without moonlight.
And find out our shining days are over.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
我們在沒有月光的黑暗中行走。
並發現我們光輝的日子已經結束。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
We follow to other shadows
and we can be real
Shadow Chasers!
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
我們追隨其他的影子，
我們才能成為真正的
逐影獵人！

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
He suggests that you become a Shadow Chaser.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
他建議你成為一名逐影獵人。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
In our guild, there is a special group that have unique skills.
They are Shadow Chasers.
They usually hide ther figure and they think they are different from others.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
在我們的公會中，有一個擁有獨特技能的特殊群體。
他們是逐影獵人。
他們通常隱藏自己的身影，並認為他們與眾不同。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Don't be so sarcastic, Vicente!
I told you.
You are qualified to be a Shadow Chaser!
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
別那麼諷刺，維森特！
我告訴過你。
你有資格成為一名逐影獵人！

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Give that brush to me.
I need it again.
I'm so thirsty.
Wait a minute.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
把刷子給我。
我還需要用它。
我渴死了。
等一下。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Let me see...
Did you bring the brush?
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
讓我看看...
你帶刷子了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
What are you doing?
Show me the brush?
You didn't bring it?
You are not very careful...
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
你在幹什麼？
給我看刷子？
你沒帶嗎？
你不太仔細啊...

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
So, do you want me to keep talking about Shadow Chasers?
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
那麼，你想讓我繼續講關於逐影獵人的事嗎？

scripts.text: What is a Shadow Chaser?
scripts.translation: 什麼是逐影獵人？

scripts.text: Change me to Shadow Chaser.
scripts.translation: 讓我成為逐影獵人。

scripts.text: I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Most spells are exclusively for Wizards and their kind.
But Knight has since been able to use a kind of magic with things called Runes.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
大多數法術是巫師及其同類專屬的。
但騎士後來也能使用一種被稱為符文的魔法。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
So we tried finding a medium for spells that suit our characteristics.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
所以我們試圖尋找一種適合我們特性的法術媒介。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
So finally...
We found paint!
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
最後...
我們找到了顏料！

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Paint gives us lots of feelings.
We can feel peaceful and happy or it can give us feelings of sorrow and fear.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
顏料能給我們很多感受。
我們可以感到平靜和快樂，或者感到悲傷和恐懼。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
We use that to harness the different emotions of people and exploit them when they're most vulnerable.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
我們利用這一點來駕馭人們不同的情緒，並在他們最脆弱時加以利用。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
The effects on our enemies are similar to that of magic spells.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
對敵人的效果類似於魔法法術。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
For instance, this power could be used to create blackholes to make your enemies vanish.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
例如，這種力量可以用來創造黑洞，讓你的敵人消失。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
So if you want to have that power then you must have artistry.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
所以，如果你想擁有這種力量，就必須有藝術感。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
You have to be a trendsetter when it comes to fashion!
The ability to understand art!
You should have everything.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
在時尚方面你必須是一個引領潮流的人！
理解藝術的能力！
你應該具備所有這些。

scripts.text: Then what is the Master Brush?
scripts.translation: 那麼什麼是大師之筆？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Ah?
That was a brush who was a master of dark arts.
Now we are looking for someone who can be a Shadow Chaser.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
啊？
那是一支精通黑暗藝術的刷子。
現在我們在尋找一個能成為逐影獵人的人。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
This is a kind of game.
If there is someone who wants to become a Shadow Chaser,
we just start the process to find this brush.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
這是一種遊戲。
如果有人想成為逐影獵人，
我們就開始尋找這把刷子的過程。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
We put the codes to make sure that you can think outside of the box.
Did you have fun?
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
我們設定這些程式碼是為了確保你能跳出思維定式。
你玩得開心嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
You decided!
As your case, you can master the art of psychological warfare using paint!
The art created is beautiful but dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
你決定了！
就你的情況而言，你可以掌握用顏料進行心理戰的藝術！
創造出的藝術是美麗但危險的。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
We use paint as a medium for spells.
We use that to harness the different emotions of people and exploit them when they're most vulnerable.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
我們將顏料作為施展法術的媒介。
藉此操控人們不同的情緒，並在他們最脆弱時加以利用。

scripts.text:

For instance, this power could be used to create black holes to make your enemies vanish.
scripts.translation:

例如，這股力量可以用來製造黑洞，讓敵人消失。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
So if you want to have that power then you must have artistry.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
所以，如果你想擁有這種力量，就必須有藝術感。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
You have to be a trendsetter when it comes to fashion!
The ability to understand art!
You should have everything.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
在時尚方面你必須是一個引領潮流的人！
理解藝術的能力！
你應該具備所有這些。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
You performed your duties diligently and found the brush.
So you are qualified to be a Shadow Chaser.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
你盡職盡責地找到了那把刷子。
因此，你已具備成為逐影獵人的資格。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Congratulations.
Welcome to your new life.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
恭喜。
歡迎開啟你的新生活。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
It's a fashionable uniform.
It uses patterns of leopard and feathers
The fashion world will be shocked.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
這是一套時尚的制服。
採用了豹紋和羽毛圖案，
時尚界一定會為之震驚。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
This shadow peacock I designed myself.
It's too hard to create something that absorbs my art sense.
Then about this part...
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
這隻影子孔雀是我親自設計的。
想要創造出能吸收我藝術感的東西實在太難了。
至於這部分...

scripts.text:
Dumk keeps talking about fashion, art sense, paint and feeling.
He's obviously in his own world.
scripts.translation:
鄧克一直在談論時尚、藝術感、顏料和感覺。
他顯然沉浸在自己的世界裡。

scripts.text: About this brush...
scripts.translation: 關於這把刷子...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Ah, I'll expain.
We need tools for painting.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
啊，我來解釋一下。
我們需要繪畫工具。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
The make-up brush is used for face painting.
You can get paint from the workplace.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
化妝刷用於面部彩繪。
你可以從工作地點獲取顏料。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
The paint brush is used for painting big spaces.
You can get paint from the workplace too.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
毛刷用於大面積繪畫。
同樣可以從工作地點獲取顏料。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Don't you remember the location of the workplace?
Juno, Prontera, Rachel and Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
你不記得工作地點的位置了嗎？
朱諾、普隆德拉、拉赫和裡希塔樂鎮。

If you need paint, go to an assistant.

如果你需要顏料，請去找助手。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Congratulations to be our person.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
恭喜你成為我們的一員。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
What?
Why not?
You don't want to be a Shadow Chaser?
I can teach you so much about painting.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
什麼？
為什麼不行？
你不想成為逐影獵人嗎？
我可以教你很多關於繪畫的知識。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
You really won't understand until you become one.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
你不成為其中一員，就永遠無法理解。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Don't you want to learn how to harness a power stronger than what you know?
....
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
你不想學習如何駕馭比你所知的更強大的力量嗎？
...

scripts.text: Dumk seemed to be dissapointed because I didn't answer him.
scripts.translation: 鄧克似乎因為我沒回答他而感到失望。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
I'm sorry.
He is not interested in other people.
But you can't enter this space.
You can get tools at the store.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
抱歉。
他對其他人不感興趣。
但你不能進入這個空間。
你可以在商店購買工具。

你很著急。
哈哈哈哈哈，人類通常都是這樣做的。
他們看不到真相。

scripts.text:

How about you?
I don't expect that you will do harm to this blue flame.
It's the only one with two...

你呢？
我不認為你會傷害這團藍色火焰。
它是唯一擁有兩個...

scripts.translation: 你是誰？

Me? I'm a deception.

I laugh behind their backs.
HahaHaha...

我？我是一個欺騙者。

我在他們背後嘲笑。
哈哈哈哈哈...

scripts.translation:

你能聽到我嗎？

你是被選中的人嗎？

scripts.text:

I'm a shadow.
A wandering shadow.
Sad soul.
A shadow of illusion without truth.
scripts.translation:
[黑衣女子]
我是一抹影子。
遊蕩的影子。
悲傷的靈魂。
沒有真實的幻影之影。

scripts.text:
[Shadow of Illusion]
What do you want?
Do you want treasure?
Then pick it up.
Tear my soul and
show the truth.
scripts.translation:
[幻影之影]
你想要什麼？
你想要寶物嗎？

撕裂我的靈魂，
展現真實。

呼呼...

scripts.text:
[Shadow of Illusion]
Ah, hurry and give me rest.
I want to die softly.
I want to give up the phony life.
scripts.translation:
[幻影之影]
啊，快點讓我安息吧。
我想安靜地死去。
我想放棄這虛假的生活。

scripts.text:

Huhu...

呼呼...
當虛假的影子消失，你就能看到真實。

escape from here!
scripts.translation:

給我一雙手，

The other side of my senses
gas for breath.

我感官的另一面，

the last pleasure.

隨著生命的開始，

When you go closer, you can't see well because of darkness.

The middle of it...

Deceive.

And {1}.

[{0}]

[{0}]

[{0}]
I got {1}.

[{0}]

[{0}]
這不是寶藏。
虛幻之鑰？這和幻影之影有關嗎？

[{0}]

Key again...

[{0}]

[{0}]

放回去
再試一次。

[{0}]

Hmm...

but nothing's coming out.
scripts.translation:
你慢慢地搖晃它。

但什麼也沒出來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]

Hmm...

scripts.text:
You shake it slowly.

[{0}]

[{0}]
...{1}...?

like a small casket with a fabulous pattern around it.
scripts.translation: 那裡有一尊石像，看起來像一個小型石棺，周圍有華麗的圖案。

deception, illusion and pleasure.

and Pleasure...

[{0}]

something comes out.

[{0}]
